_doc: build_versions.py knobs. endcards: per-version backdrop still for frames 1890-2099 (null/missing -> the end card as it is in the picture). endcard_look: dim = overall brightness of the still, band = extra darkening behind boat/title/names (0..1), zoom = push-in over 7 s. inserts: list of {from, to, clip, offset, crop, y, speed, grade, box, enabled, note} per version or 'all' - replace picture frames from..to (inclusive) with clip (offset = seconds into the SOURCE clip; speed 0.8 = 24 fps frames played at 30 fps, so a plan of N frames uses N/24 s of clip; crop w:h:x:y applied to the clip first, default 1920:804:0:y with y=138; grade = ffmpeg filter chain, default eq=contrast=1.1:saturation=1.12 (measured: Kling lifts blacks ~+12 Y and drops saturation vs our CG source frames); box x:y:w:h target, default the 2.39 picture area 0:138:1920:804). endcard_look also takes fit (true: wide still kept whole inside the 2.39 band with bars), band_y/band_w (centre/width of the dark band), zoom0/shift_x (start zoom; horizontal shift, negative moves the still right).
